result.title: An Explicit Feedback Contract for Iterative ML-Agent Harnesses
result.summary: Iterative ML agents develop models by editing code, running experiments, reading a validation score, and choosing what to try next. In current harnesses this loop is served by an exact validation score returned after every attempt, which leaves the validation split open to adaptive selection. In this work, we introduce an explicit feedback contract for ML-agent harnesses, which specifies what an agent may observe, when iteration should stop, and when the test split may be touched. The contract releases a validation score only when a submission clears a noise threshold computed from the paired standard error, so no margin has to be tuned. We ran experiments on click-through-rate prediction, learning to rank, and a control task with no signal to find. The control is the sharpest case, because the true gain there is zero by construction: an agent reading exact scores ended by reporting a gain of 0.0157, while under the contract it reported 0.0033. On both real tasks the contract narrows the validation-test gap, and test performance is slightly higher rather than lower. The largest difference is in when the agents stop. Exact feedback used its entire budget of thirty submissions on two of the three tasks, including the one where nothing can be learned, while the contract halted after four to twelve. A run that exhausts its budget is usually read as diligence. It is better read as a symptom: when the feedback channel is unbounded, noise keeps supplying improvements to chase.

AI.brief_summary: 论文为迭代式 ML agent 提出「显式反馈契约」，规定 agent 能观察到什么、何时停止迭代、何时可触碰测试集，并在验证分数达到由配对标准误算出的噪声阈值时才释放；在 CTR 预测、learning to rank 和一个无信号对照任务上检验了停止时机与验证—测试差距。
AI.relevance_reason: 其中基于噪声阈值的反馈释放与「无限反馈通道会持续追逐噪声」的停止分析，可能为 LVR 中 THINK/LOOK/STOP 的停止决策与噪声证据筛选提供借鉴线索，但需核查其从 ML-agent 实验循环迁移到多模态 latent 推理的可行性。
